selection: 36 development receiver-visits positive under the packed unseeded reference; fixed controls evaluated independently afterward
oracle_timing: use the reference-selected 20 ms window and floor(reference fitted epoch_samples); this supplies detector outcome timing and is not an acquisition result
center_score: NativeKnownStateV3 frame_limit=2, recover_timing=false, expected_physical_cfo_hz equal to scoring center; rank centers by exact_score-control_score with declared center order as tie break
physical_cfo_proposal: selected center plus the returned GLRT residual, represented by tracking_cfo_hz
success: selected margin strictly greater than 0.025 and proposed physical CFO within 8000 Hz of the packed reference CFO

timing.candidate_scope: natural-stride selected 20 ms view plus every declared center call
timing.comparison: same-case packed unseeded maximum=1 blind confirmation fine_cpu_ms

stopping_rule: do not promote if either variant proposes wrong CFO for reference positives, changes fixed control decisions, or total center cost dominates the measured fine stage
interpretation: truth-supplied timing feasibility diagnostic only; it does not establish blind acquisition, physical identity, or absence
